The '''New Cov asteroid field''' was an ice [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Churba system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. During the [[Galactic War]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] tried to hide in the New Cov asteroid field and fortify their position with prototype mines, but they were [[Battle in the New Cov ice field|stopped]] by [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] forces.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|New Cov Ice Field}}</ref>
